conclusion: On 255 identical held-out test images, CLAHE preprocessing (Variant B) achieved 81.57% accuracy (Macro F1 0.7784) vs Baseline (Variant A) at 67.84% accuracy (Macro F1 0.6608), a delta of +13.73 percentage points.
